The '''Mk-11 Droid Diagnostic''' was a small handheld [[Computer/Legends|computer]] manufactured by [[Interstellar Droid Monitoring, Inc.]] It included a scanner and was about twice the size of a standard [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].

==Usage==
It was designed to be plugged into a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. It would gather data on the droid and display it on its screen, along with problems and possible solutions.
